page: Microsoft Azure E192ids_v6 is an isolated, memory-optimized server belonging to the Edsv6 family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz. The server features 192 virtual CPUs mapped to 96 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, utilizing dedicated CPU allocation. It is equipped with 1832.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 9.54 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance includes 11339 GB of local disk capacity and is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark evaluations place the E192ids_v6 in the top tier for multi-core processing and memory bandwidth. The stress-ng multi-core CPU performance score of 158923.19 and the PassMark CPU score of 122297.6 demonstrate high parallel processing capabilities, although single-core performance remains in the average tier. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, reaching 12329.57 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 430.1 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. Database operations and Redis SET benchmarks also rank in the top tier, with Redis achieving 179.31 million operations per second.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the E192ids_v6 offers high resource density, combining massive memory capacity with substantial local storage on a single isolated host. The primary tradeoff is the average single-core performance compared to its top-tier multi-core capabilities. This hardware profile is highly suited for memory-intensive workloads, large-scale database operations, high-throughput web serving, and multi-threaded data processing tasks.
